episodes.title: Wildcat is Down
episodes.summary: It's just another day in Paradise until Xavier Collins discovers one of the world's most powerful individuals has been viciously murdered. Xavier analyzes the crime scene while recalling his complex relationship with the victim.

episodes.title: Sinatra
episodes.summary: Agent Xavier Collins is interrogated. Samantha Redmond (codenamed Sinatra) begins to reassure the community as she reflects on how she got to Paradise.

episodes.title: The Architect of Social Well-Being
episodes.summary: Isolated, Xavier seeks answers on his own and cautiously turns to Dr. Gabriela Torabi. Meanwhile, Billy and Jane feel the pressure from Robinson's investigation.

episodes.title: Agent Billy Pace
episodes.summary: The citizens of Paradise celebrate at the annual carnival. Xavier and Billy delve deeper into their investigation.

episodes.title: In the Palaces of Crowned Kings
episodes.summary: Xavier faces the consequences of his investigation, forcing him to consider how to proceed. Meanwhile Cal's family history and his last days are examined.

episodes.title: You Asked for Miracles
episodes.summary: Xavier and Robinson set their plans in motion while Sinatra works to preserve the status quo in Paradise.

episodes.title: The Day
episodes.summary: Sinatra and Xavier confront the past, returning to the harrowing day that brought them to Paradise.

episodes.title: The Man Who Kept the Secrets
episodes.summary: Xavier and Robinson race to find President Bradford's murderer before it's too late.

episodes.title: Graceland
episodes.summary: Annie is a tour guide in Memphis, TN when the world ends. Her survival in the ensuing years after The Day is revealed as well as her encounter with a traveling group of survivors.

episodes.title: Mayday
episodes.summary: Xavier battles the elements and other threats as he follows a broadcast to Atlanta in search of his wife, Teri.

episodes.title: Another Day in Paradise
episodes.summary: Sinatra wakes to discover a new paradigm in the bunker and takes steps to safeguard its biggest secret.

episodes.title: A Holy Charge
episodes.summary: Xavier and Annie travel to Atlanta, contrasting life in this new world and the one he left behind in the bunker.

episodes.title: The Mailman
episodes.summary: Xavier meets Gary and learns what happened to Teri on The Day.

episodes.title: Jane
episodes.summary: Xavier and Gary set their plan in motion. Back in Paradise, Sinatra takes action, while Gabriela follows a new lead, and Jane's past is revealed.

episodes.title: The Final Countdown
episodes.summary: Xavier has unfinished business. Meanwhile, Sinatra meets with Link as Paradise prepares for a potential threat.

episodes.title: Exodus
episodes.summary: Worlds collide. Time is of the essence for Xavier. Link and his team spring into action. Sinatra puts it all on the line.
